title: Production Team (PD)
description: (ENG) The Team You're Joining The Production Team sits within SFOC's Communications Division, creating visual content that brings climate issues to life for wider audiences - spanning video, design, and digital campaigns across SFOC's channels and thematic programmes. As Creative Director of our in-house production team, you'll shape the visual identity of SFOC's content and lead the creative direction across all visual output and design branding. How You'll Contribute Disseminate and raise awareness of climate-related topics to wider audiences through visual content (video, images, and more) Plan and produce regular and original video content that contributes to climate communication across digital channels Collaborate with SFOC's thematic programme teams to deliver campaigns through visual content Lead SFOC's design branding as Creative Director of the in-house production team Who We're Looking For 2+ years of video production experience with a strong portfolio Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent editing software Ability to create motion graphics using After Effects or similar tools On-location filming skills including lighting setup and audio management Strong research and fact-checking skills; ability to handle complex climate and energy topics accurately Excellent understanding of content trends on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn Familiarity with scripting for long-form and short-form video Nice to Have Strong creative planning and production skills with a high sensitivity to film and visuals Experience in integrated projects where messages are developed across multiple forms of production Ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders Genuine empathy for SFOC's vision and mission A collaborative mindset with respect for a diverse and inclusive organizational culture Self-motivated with the ability to find drive in a flexible work environment Please Read Carefully Please submit your CV, cover letter, and portfolio in English, in PDF format. A portfolio is required. At SFOC, we may suggest other roles based on your experience and strengths, even if they differ from the position you applied for. We'd love to find the best fit for your potential. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities and are committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants. The role begins as a 1-year contract, with the possibility of a 1-year extension based on team feedback. Conversion to a permanent position will be considered after 2 years of continuous employment. E-7 visa sponsorship is available for successful candidates where needed, subject to eligibility requirements. SFOC는 지원하신 직무 외에도 역량과 경력에 따라 다른 포지션을 제안드릴 수 있어요. 지원자분의 잠재력을 가장 잘 발휘할 수 있는 자리를 함께 찾아보고 싶습니다. 장애인 지원자를 우대하며, 모든 분께 동등한 기회를 드립니다. 1년 계약직으로 시작하며, 팀원 피드백을 바탕으로 1년 연장이 가능해요. 계속 근로 2년 후에는 정규직 전환을 검토합니다. 합격자에게는 필요 시 E-7 비자 발급을 지원해 드려요. 단, E-7 비자 발급 자격 요건을 충족하시는 분에 한합니다. 채용서류 반환에 관한 안내
